title: `Strain measure` heading survives the congestion sweep inside an edited spec-4-1 line
evidence: - **Strain measure (the pinned contract):** node utilization = Σ `packet_bandwidth` of packets RESIDENT at the node that **FAILED a forward attempt** (`Packet.waiting_ticks >= 1` — incremented in flow.odin's forward pass when no route exists, cleared on every successful forward) × 100 ÷ `node_types[node_type].throughput_units` (integer percent). A packet that forwards next tick — fresh spawn OR fresh transit arrival — has `waiting_ticks` 0 and NEVER congests (the no-flicker contract; the transit case was the reason the spawn-tick exclusion alone was insufficient — see the change log). Pipe congestion = the FULLEST lane queue's depth on the bundle vs its E9 bound (`lane_queue_packets × packet_bandwidth`): a lone packet is 1/6 of a bound (17 %, healthy); a lane at its bound (6 packets) is 100 % — the ladder is dropping. "Congestion climbing toward saturation" (GDD M5), not busy-ness.
detail: The PR rewrote this exact line (NEVER strains → NEVER congests; Pipe pressure → Pipe congestion) but left the pinned-contract heading naming the retired coinage — a missed rename in a swept surface.
recommended_fix: Rename the heading to "Congestion measure (the pinned contract)" to match the line's body and the canon.

title: Idiomatic "time pressure" / "sustained pressure" / "pressure-riser" mis-renamed to "congestion" in GDD prose
evidence:
| **P3** | **Readable, fair crisis triage** — predict the next crisis from warning signs and react in time; "I should have seen this coming," never random `[FORGE #3]`. | Warning-sign system, crisis archetypes, failure fairness, time congestion. |
- **During crises (triage mode):** the player prioritizes and reroutes under time congestion — the crisis layer (P3). Failure state here is *fast SLA collapse*.
- the cloud era is long sustained congestion. This is the *pacing* layer of the crisis model
- **Pause anytime** — the player can pause to assess/redesign without time congestion; crises tick down only while unpaused.
- **Mood:** urgency-driven — ambient beds between crises, congestion-riser stings as warning signs climb
- **Pause anytime** — no real-time-congestion-only design; the player can always stop to think (core to the fair-crisis model).
detail: The ruling's pressure→congestion coinage is the pipe-warning metric (Pipe_Pressure / pipe_pressure_lead_ticks); "time pressure" means urgency. "time congestion", "real-time-congestion-only", "congestion-riser" are meaningless, and the canon explicitly allows metaphor prose to keep "pressure".
recommended_fix: Restore "time pressure" at 73/107/367/565, "sustained pressure" at 291, "pressure-riser" at 555; reserve congestion for the pipe-warning metric.

title: "Modernization pressure" mis-renamed to "modernization congestion" across four canon docs
evidence:
**Delivers** modernization congestion. MVP ships **one** transition (Email → Streaming). *Playable value: the player experiences the internet evolving and must modernize.*
5. **E5** (one era transition) — the modernization congestion.
- **Map growth:** organic, Mini Motorways-style — nodes (brands, neighborhoods, data centers) appear over time and spread apart, driving the modernization congestion (legacy pipes can't span the new distances, M1).
**Goal.** Modernization congestion. The GDD MVP (E1–E9) **includes** one era transition; this
**→ Slice 6 exit:** modernization congestion is felt — the internet evolves, you must keep up.
detail: "Modernization pressure" is the P4 pacing concept (pressure to modernize), not the pipe-warning metric; "modernization congestion is felt" is not meaningful prose and contradicts the canon's allowance for metaphor prose.
recommended_fix: Restore "modernization pressure" in epics.md:75,154, gdd.md:478, sprint-plan-v2.md:256, stories-v2.md:873.
